title: Sonar Depth Band with Best Hookups
dataSources: Fishing catches (`fishing:catch`), fishfinder sonar (`fishfinder:reading`), foraging finds (`foraging:find`), game-cam triggers (`gamecam:trigger`).
app: Outdoor logs — fishing apps (Fishbrain), sonar / fishfinder exports, game/trail cameras, and foraging journals — streamed to Splunk HEC via APIs and scripted inputs.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=fishfinder:reading
| stats avg(fish_density) as avg_density, count as pings by depth_band
| sort - avg_density
description: Shows which depth bands most consistently show promising sonar activity before hookups.
value: A depth-band view helps turn sonar from a moving picture into something you can use on the next drift or cast.
implementation: Bucket fishfinder readings into depth bands in `index=personal`; compare average density and ping volume by band.
visualization: Depth-band table of average fish density and ping count.
grandmaExplanation: It warns which depths most often show the sonar activity that leads to better chances of a hookup.
